answer: A mycology foray record with fungus survey history works as the gate: forays led for one society across many autumns. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The zephyr signal separates the two cases at a glance: Each of 277 aliases needs its own foray records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The jetty ledger records each payment, the canyon window resets the board, and 277 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
